blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-shot adaptation often relies on an encoder's final global representation, leaving complementary information in intermediate layers underused. Combining these features is challenging because their dimensions can differ and their usefulness varies across tasks. We propose LAMP, Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors, a training-free framework that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers. A single forward pass per view supplies all descriptors. Global and support-calibrated regional kernel predictors independently fit the same label residuals. Labeled validation data select their mixture in class-score space, preserving native feature dimensions without learned projections. LAMP-F further adapts text-anchored class prototypes, using a cached response to update the fixed-kernel residual predictions exactly. Experiments cover eleven datasets and ViT and ResNet backbones. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared published training-free ResNet-50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. Averaged across five support budgets, LAMP improves over a paired global-feature-only baseline by 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points on ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. LAMP-F reaches 16-shot accuracies of 83.57% and 79.10%, respectively. Controlled experiments identify multi-layer integration as the main source of improvement and examine pooling, calibration, validation labels, and computational cost. These findings show that combining layer-specific predictions can exploit complementary features from frozen encoders to improve few-shot classification.
blocks.zh: 很少镜头的改编往往依赖于编码器的最终全球代表,使中间层的补充信息没有得到充分利用. 综合这些特征具有挑战性,因为其层面可能不同,其用途因任务而异。 我们提议采用LAMP,“对预测器进行图层适应性混合”,这是一种无培训框架,将来自多层编码器的全球和区域信息结合起来。 每道取景都有一个前传,提供所有描述符。 全球与支持校正区域内核预测器独立地匹配同名标签残基. 标签验证数据在分级空间中选择它们的混合物,在没有学到的预测的情况下保留了本地地物维度. LAMP-F进一步调整了文本焦虑类原型,使用缓存响应来精确更新固定内核剩余预测. 实验涵盖11个数据集和ViT和ResNet主干. LAMP在比较公布的无训练ResNet-50方法中,以4,8和16发的成绩达到最先进的平均准确度,以16发的成绩达到78.73%. 平均在5个支助预算中,LAMP在VIT-B/16和ResNet-50上将单对全球地物基线提高1.14和1.59个百分点;LAMP-F将这些收益提高到1.96和2.54个百分点。 LAMP-F的射速分别达到83.57%和79.10%. 受控实验确定多层次整合为改进的主要来源并检查集合,校准,验证标签和计算成本. 这些发现表明,结合地层特异性预测可以从被冻结的编码器中利用互补特征来改进几发分级.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language models such as CLIP recognize images by matching visual representations to category descriptions [ 1 ] . Few-shot adaptation uses a small labeled support set to improve this pretrained predictor for a target task. Many adaptation methods rely on the encoder’s final global descriptor. This compact representation supports image–text matching, but intermediate token grids and convolutional maps also retain visual information at different levels of abstraction. These features are already available during the encoder’s forward pass. Using them offers an opportunity to improve adaptation while keeping the encoder frozen.
blocks.zh: Vision - CLIP等语言模型通过将视觉表达与类别描述相匹配来识别图像 [1]. 很少镜头的适应使用一个有小标签的支援集来改进这个对目标任务的预先训练的预测器. 许多适应方法依赖于编码器的最终全球描述符. 这种紧凑的表示支持图像-文本匹配,但中间的令牌网格和演化图也保留了不同抽象层次的视觉信息. 在编码器前传时,这些功能已经存在。 利用它们为改进适应提供了机会,同时使编码器被冻结.

blocks.en: Existing approaches use different sources of information to adapt the predictor. Prompt and prototype methods refine the class representations [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Tip-Adapter retrieves labeled instances, while ProKeR fits a regularized support-label residual; both use final global descriptors to match images [ 5 , 6 ] . SSP instead uses local features to construct subspaces for image–text alignment [ 7 ] . These methods motivate the use of complementary semantic and visual information. Integrating features from several encoder layers, however, requires addressing two related challenges: their native dimensions can differ, and the most useful layers can vary with the target task.
blocks.zh: 现有方法使用不同的信息来源来调整预测器. 即时和原型方法完善了阶级表述[2,3,4]. Tip-Adapter 重取被标记的例,而ProKER 则符合正则化的支持-标签剩余;两者都使用最终全局描述符来匹配图像 [5, 6]. SSP转而使用本地特性来构建图像-文本对齐的子空间[7]. 这些方法激励人们使用互补的语义和视觉信息. 然而,整合几个编码器层的特征需要解决两个相关的挑战:其本土维度可以不同,最有用的层可以随目标任务而不同.

blocks.en: Our central idea is to combine predictions from different layers in a shared class-score space. Different layers provide different measures of image similarity, but each predictor outputs a score for the same set of classes. Their predictions can therefore be combined while preserving the original feature dimensions. Fitting these predictors separately also allows their outputs to be reused when selecting the mixture, so each candidate mixture does not require a new fit.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心思想是在共享的分级空间中结合不同层次的预测. 不同的地层提供了图像相似性的不同度量,但每个预测器输出一个同一组类的分数. 因此,它们的预测可以在保留原地貌维度的同时被合并. 将这些预测器分开处理,也使得它们在选择混合物时的输出可以被再用,因此每个候选混合物不需要新的配体.

blocks.en: Based on this idea, we introduce training-free LAMP , L ayerwise A daptive M ixing of P redictors. A single encoder pass per view yields a global descriptor and regional descriptors from three layers of a Vision Transformer (ViT) or ResNet [ 8 , 9 ] . The global predictor and three regional predictors independently fit the same label residual: the difference between the support labels and CLIP’s initial scores. Each regional kernel is calibrated against the support set, and labeled validation data select the mixture of global and regional corrections. LAMP thus uses complementary information from several layers without gradient optimization or learned feature projections. Its extension, LAMP-F, adapts text-anchored class prototypes while retaining the selected kernels and mixture weights. A cached linear response accounts exactly for the resulting changes to both the initial scores and residual corrections, avoiding repeated matrix factorization during prototype evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基于这个想法,我们引入了无训练LAMP,Layerwise A daptive Mixing of P redicters. 每个视图的单个编码器传出一个全局描述符和区域描述符,从一个视觉变形器(ViT)或ResNet[8,9]分出三层. 全球预测器和三个区域预测器独立地符合相同的标签剩余:支持标签与CLIP初始分数的相差. 每个区域内核根据支持集进行校正,并有标签的验证数据选择全球和区域校正的混合. 因此,LAMP使用几个层次的补充信息,没有梯度优化或学到的特征预测. 它的扩展LAMP-F在保留所选的内核和混合物重量的同时,也适应了文本焦虑类原型. 一个缓存的线性反应账户,准确地说明最初的分数和剩余校正结果的变动,避免了原型评价中重复的矩阵因子化.

blocks.en: We evaluate LAMP on eleven datasets, five support budgets, and CLIP backbones from the ViT and ResNet families. In the comparison with published training-free ResNet-50 (RN50) methods, LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. LAMP-F reaches 83.57% and 79.10% at 16 shots on ViT-B/16 and RN50, respectively. Across the eleven datasets and five support budgets, LAMP improves over our paired global-feature-only baseline by an average of 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. Controlled comparisons identify the integration of multiple encoder layers as the main source of improvement and examine the effects of regional pooling and calibration. Experiments with RN101 and ViT-B/32, together with transfer to ImageNet-V2 and ImageNet-Sketch, assess generalization across architectures and image distributions [ 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们根据11个数据集、5个支助预算以及来自VIT和ResNet家庭的CLIP主干网对LAMP进行评估。 与已公布的免费培训ResNet-50(RN50)方法相比,LAMP在4,8和16发中实现了最先进的平均精度,在16发中达到了78.73%. LAMP-F在Vit-B/16和RN50上分别射出16发子弹,分别达到83.57%和79.10%. 在11个数据集和5个支助预算中,LAMP比我们的配对全球地物基线平均提高了1.14和1.59个百分点;LAMP-F将这些收益提高到1.96和2.54个百分点。 受控比较将多层编码器的整合确定为改进的主要来源并考察了区域集合和校正的效果. RN101和ViT-B/32的实验,连同向ImageNet-V2和ImageNet-Sketch的传输,评估了跨架构和图像分布的通论[10,11].

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. We introduce LAMP, a training-free method that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers using independently fitted kernel predictors. Regional kernels are calibrated against the support set. Score-level fusion preserves native feature dimensions, and separating branch fitting from mixture selection makes predictions reusable across candidates. 2. We develop LAMP-F, which combines prototype adaptation with the same global and regional predictors. For fixed kernels and mixture weights, its cached response exactly updates both the initial class scores and residual corrections as the prototypes change. 3. We demonstrate state-of-the-art mean accuracy in the published training-free RN50 comparison at 4, 8, and 16 shots across eleven datasets. Paired comparisons on ViT and ResNet backbones establish the accuracy gains, and controlled experiments explain the contribution of multi-layer integration.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. 我们采用LAMP这一无培训方法,利用独立安装的内核预测器,将多个编码层的全球和区域信息结合起来。 区域内核根据支持集进行校正. 分数级聚变保留了原生地特征维度,将接合分枝与混合物选择相分离,使得预测在考生之间可以重复使用. 2. 我们开发了LAMP-F,将原型适应与同样的全球和区域预测器结合起来。 对于固定内核和混合物权重,它的缓存反应在原型改变时,精确地更新了初始分数和剩余校正. 3. 在公布的无培训RN50比较中,我们在11个数据集的4、8和16发子弹中表现出最先进的平均准确性。 对ViT和ResNet主干线的Paired比较确定了精度增益,受控实验解释了多层集成的贡献.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Class-level semantic adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 级语义适应

blocks.en: Semantic adaptation adjusts a vision–language model’s class representations to a target task. CoOp and CoCoOp learn contextual prompts, while KgCoOp and ProGrad constrain prompt updates to preserve pretrained knowledge [ 2 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] . MaPLe couples visual and textual prompts; PLOT and CAPEL use multiple prompts or class representations to capture variation within a category [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . TaskRes learns residual updates to class prototypes, while CLAP adapts prototypes with a text-anchoring penalty [ 3 , 4 ] . These methods improve the class representations through optimization. LAMP keeps the class text vectors fixed and uses visual similarities to correct their prediction errors on the support set. Its trainable extension, LAMP-F, combines CLAP’s text anchoring with global and regional residual predictors. Cached responses account for the effects of prototype updates on both the initial query scores and the support residuals, allowing prototype adaptation to work with the selected visual predictors.
blocks.zh: 语义适应将视觉-语言模型的类表现调整为目标任务. CoOp和CoCoOp学习上下文提示,而KgCoOp和ProGrad则会约束即时更新来保存被预训的知识[2,12,13,14]. MaPLe夫妇的视觉和文字提示; PLOT和CAPEL使用多个提示或类表示来捕捉某类中的变化[15,16,17]. TaskRes学习了对类原型的剩余更新,而CLAP则以文本查询罚[3,4]来调整原型. 这些方法通过优化改进了阶级表现. LAMP保持类文本向量固定,并使用视觉相似性来纠正其在支持集上的预测错误. 它的可训练扩展LAMP-F结合了CLAP的文本锚定与全球和区域剩余预测器. 缓存回放说明原型更新对初始查询分数和支持后遗症的影响,使原型适应能够与所选的视觉预测器配合.

blocks.en: 2.2 Instance-level global adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 实例一级的全球适应

blocks.en: Instance-level adaptation draws on visual information from labeled support images. CLIP-Adapter learns transformations of global embeddings, and CLIP-LoRA updates internal attention weights through low-rank parameters [ 18 , 19 ] . Both adapt visual representations through gradient optimization. Training-free methods instead adjust how frozen features are used for prediction: Tip-Adapter retrieves support labels, APE refines feature channels and affinities, and GDA estimates class statistics [ 5 , 20 , 21 ] . IDEA combines image similarities with similarities between image captions, and T-IDEA further learns alignment and bias correction [ 22 ] . LAMP obtains complementary features from intermediate encoder layers and combines their predictions. This allows it to use information beyond the final global descriptor while preserving each layer’s original feature space.
blocks.zh: 实例级的适应取自标签支持图像的视觉信息. CLIP-Adapter学习了全球嵌入的变换,CLIP-LORA通过低等参数来更新内部的注意力分量 [18, 19]. 两者都通过梯度优化来调整视觉表现. 无培训方法则调整冷冻特性如何用于预测: Tip-Adapter 检索支持标签,APE 精细特性通道和亲和度, GDA 估计类统计 [5, 20, 21]. EIDEA将图像相似性与图像标题相似性结合起来,而T-IDEA进一步学习了对齐和偏差校正[22]. LAMP从中间编码层获得互补特征并结合了它们的预测. 这允许它使用超越最终全球描述符的信息,同时保留了每层的原始特征空间.

blocks.en: LAMP uses ProKeR’s residual kernel formulation, which transfers corrections from support images to queries according to global-feature similarities [ 6 ] . It fits a global predictor and separate regional predictors whose kernels are calibrated against the support set. Combining their outputs in class-score space preserves each branch’s feature dimensions and similarity structure; labeled validation data determine their relative contributions. Since the branches are fitted independently, their predictions can be reused when evaluating different mixtures. LAMP-F also exploits their linear dependence on the support residual to cache the combined response to prototype updates.
blocks.zh: LAMP使用ProKER的剩余内核配方,根据全球地貌相似性将支持图像的校正转移到了查询 [6]. 它适合一个全球预测器和单独的区域预测器,其内核被校准于支持集. 将它们在类分数空间中的输出结合起来,可以保存每个分支的特征尺寸和相似性结构;标签验证数据决定其相对贡献. 由于分枝是独立安装的,在评价不同的混合物时,它们的预测可以被再用. LAMP-F还利用他们对支持后遗症的线性依赖来缓存对原型更新的综合响应.

blocks.en: 2.3 Patch- and region-level adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 补丁和区域一级的适应

blocks.en: Selective Vision-Language Subspace Projection (SSP) uses local features to construct visual and class-specific language subspaces for image–text alignment without gradient optimization [ 7 ] . Both SSP and LAMP use information beyond a single global descriptor, but they integrate it differently. SSP improves cross-modal alignment through subspace projection. LAMP uses regional features from several encoder layers to fit the same support-label residual and then combines the resulting class scores. Because all branches predict the same classes, their outputs can be combined even when their feature dimensions differ. A single encoder pass per view provides all regional descriptors. LAMP uses generalized-mean pooling for convolutional activations [ 23 ] and kernel-mean comparisons of descriptor sets [ 24 ] . Comparisons with simpler summaries of the same layers distinguish the benefit of using multiple layers from that of retaining regional descriptor sets.
blocks.zh: 选择性Vision-Language Subspace Projection(SSP)使用本地特性来构建图像-文本对齐的视觉和类特有语言子空间而不进行梯度优化[7]. SSP和LAMP都使用超过一个单一的全球描述符的信息,但是它们将其融合在一起的方式不同. SSP通过子空间投影改进了跨模式对接. LAMP使用从几个编码器层出的区域特征来匹配相同的支持-标签残基,再将由此产生的类分相组合. 因为所有分支都预测相同的类,所以即使它们的特征维度不同,它们的输出也可以被合并. 每个取景器的单一编码器通过可以提供所有区域的描述符. LAMP使用通用-正元集合来进行分解活化活化[23]和内核-正元比较描述集[24]. 与同层的更简单的摘要比较,可以区分使用多层和保留区域描述集的好处。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: LAMP adapts CLIP by using labeled support images to correct its initial class scores. The support labels indicate which scores should increase or decrease, and visual similarity determines how these corrections transfer to a query. Global descriptors and regional features from intermediate layers capture different relationships between images, providing complementary ways to correct a prediction. LAMP combines the resulting corrections in class-score space: every branch produces one score per class, even when the branches have different feature dimensions.
blocks.zh: LAMP通过使用有标签的支持图像来调整CLIP来修正其初始类分. 支持标签表示哪些分数应该增加或减少,视觉相似性决定这些更正如何转移到查询. 全球描述符和中间层的区域特征捕捉到图像之间的不同关系,为修正预测提供了互补的方法. LAMP结合了由此而来在类分空间中的校正:每个分会每个分会产生一分,即使分会具有不同的特征维度.

blocks.en: We first introduce the residual target and global predictor using ProKeR’s residual kernel formulation [ 6 ] . We then explain how intermediate layers provide regional descriptors, how their similarities are calibrated, and how the resulting predictors fit the same target. Validation determines the contribution of each predictor. LAMP-F further adapts the class prototypes while keeping the selected visual kernels and mixture weights fixed. Figure 1 illustrates the method with a ViT backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用 ProKER 的剩余内核配方来引入剩余目标和全球预测器 [6]. 然后我们解释中间层如何提供区域描述符,它们的相似性如何被校正,以及由此产生的预测符如何匹配同一目标。 验证确定每个预测器的贡献. LAMP-F进一步调整了类原型,同时将所选取的视觉内核和混合物重量固定. 图1用ViT主干说明方法.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate recognition accuracy at different support budgets and examine how
class-prototype adaptation and native-layer integration contribute to performance.
We also test transfer to new domains without fitting on target data and measure
deployment costs. Comparisons with published methods establish overall performance,
while paired controls assess individual design choices.
blocks.zh:
我们评价不同支助预算的识别准确性,并审查如何
阶级原型的适应和本土层次的融合有助于业绩。
我们还测试在没有目标数据和测量的情况下向新域的转移
部署费用。 与公布方法的比较确定总体业绩,
同时配对控制评估单个设计选择.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate training-free LAMP and its prototype-adapted extension, LAMP-F, with CLIP encoders from the ViT and ResNet families. The main comparison covers eleven datasets using ViT-B/16 and RN50, with 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 support images per class and three support-sampling seeds. Additional experiments use RN101 and ViT-B/32. We report top-1 accuracy and give each dataset equal weight when computing the mean.
blocks.zh: 我们评价无培训的LAMP及其原型适应扩展,LAMP-F,配有来自VIT和ResNet家族的CLIP编码器. 主要比较包括使用VIT-B/16和RN50的11个数据集,每类有1,2,4,8和16个支持图像以及3个支持抽样种子. 其他实验使用RN101和Vit-B/32. 我们报告最高一号的准确度,并在计算平均值时给每个数据集相等的权重.

blocks.en: We follow the established benchmark partitions and evaluation conventions used in previous studies [ 2 , 5 , 6 ] . Labeled validation images are not counted toward the support budget. Paired controls use the same support images, augmented views, prompts, and query images. Results taken from published baselines retain their original protocols. Confidence intervals for our experiments are conditional on the selected models.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循以往研究中使用的既定基准划分和评价惯例[2、5、6]。 标签验证图像不计入支助预算。 Paired控件使用相同的支持图像,增强视图,提示和查询图像. 从已公布的基线中获得的结果保留其原始协议。 我们实验的信心间隔取决于选定的模型。

blocks.en:
Ten datasets have distinct validation and test lists. For ImageNet, support
images come from the training partition, while the same official 50,000-image
validation partition is used for both parameter selection and benchmark
scoring, following the released Tip-Adapter and ProKeR implementations.
The eleven-dataset aggregate therefore combines these evaluation protocols.
Published comparisons retain their different selection procedures:
CLIP-LoRA shares hyperparameters across tasks, whereas LAMP uses
dataset-specific validation.
blocks.zh:
10个数据集有不同的验证和测试清单. 对于图像网, 支持
图像来自训练分区, 而同一官方 50,000-图像
参数选择和基准均使用验证分区
评分,跟随发布的Tip-Adapter和ProKER执行.
因此,11个数据集的汇总综合了这些评价协议。
公布的比较保留其不同的甄选程序:
CLIP-LORA在任务之间共享超参数,而LAMP则使用
数据集特定验证。

blocks.en:
Paired analyses of the three-seed benchmark and its controls use 5,000
paired crossed bootstrap replicates, with shared support-seed and
class-stratified query-identity draws. Selected models remain fixed during
resampling. The benchmark tasks were used during method development;
these intervals do not cover repeated-selection or development uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
对三种子基准及其控制的分析
相配的交叉靴子复制,共享支持种子和
类分级的查询识别绘图。 选定模型在
复作相会. 制定方法时使用了基准任务;
这些间隔并不包括反复选择或发展的不确定性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with state-of-the-art methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
We compare LAMP and LAMP-F with representative published methods for prompt
learning, feature adaptation, and support matching across five support budgets.
Tables 1 and 2 report mean
accuracy over eleven datasets for ViT-B/16 and RN50. The methods included in
each comparison depend on their backbone requirements and the availability of
published results. For example, MaPLe [ 15 ] inserts deep visual prompts
into Transformer blocks and is evaluated with ViT-B/16. SSP [ 7 ] reports
eleven-dataset mean accuracy at all five support budgets for RN50, but does
not report the corresponding means for ViT-B/16. We therefore use the
ViT-B/16 results reported by CLIP-LoRA and CAPEL [ 19 , 17 ] to compare with methods that require training, and the RN50 results reported
by ProKeR and SSP [ 6 , 7 ] to compare with training-free methods.

blocks.en:
LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the training-free RN50
methods compared at 4, 8, and 16 shots. At 16 shots, it reaches 78.73%,
exceeding the best published training-free result by 1.98 percentage points
without gradient optimization.

The ViT-B/16 comparison includes published methods that require training.
LAMP exceeds CLIP-LoRA, the strongest published baseline at 8 and 16 shots,
by 0.35 and 0.30 points, respectively, without gradient-based training.
LAMP-F further raises mean accuracy to 80.94% and 83.57%. CLIP-LoRA
updates encoder weights, while LAMP keeps both the encoders and class
prototypes fixed; LAMP-F optimizes only the class prototypes. These results
show that combining residual corrections from multiple depths can achieve
competitive accuracy with a frozen encoder and fixed text prototypes.

blocks.en: At four shots, integrating native-layer features improves mean accuracy across the eleven datasets by 1.446 points with ViT and 1.568 with RN50 (Table 5 ). The largest gains occur on EuroSAT: 5.860 and 6.695 points, respectively. Mean accuracy increases on all eleven datasets with ViT and on ten with RN50; the RN50 change on SUN397 is − 0.032 -0.032 points. Native-layer integration is particularly effective for satellite imagery and, with ViT, texture recognition.

blocks.en: Prototype adaptation benefits a different set of tasks. Its largest 4-shot gains occur on SUN397, at 5.620 points with ViT and 6.715 with RN50. Prototype adaptation and native-layer integration thus benefit different tasks: the former adjusts class directions, while the latter changes how support evidence is used to correct the initial CLIP scores.

blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Implications for training-free adaptation
blocks.zh: 5.1 对无培训适应的影响

blocks.en:
LAMP improves adaptation by combining complementary features from different
encoder layers. The final global descriptor provides image–text alignment,
while intermediate feature maps supply additional visual information for the
target task. Controls with matched search budgets show that descriptors from
multiple layers outperform an ensemble built from the final global feature.
Likewise, pooling several feature maps outperforms pooling only the deepest
map. In the pooling study, regional centroids and whole-map descriptors retain
most of the accuracy gain. These compact representations offer useful options
for applications with limited storage or strict latency requirements.

blocks.en:
Calibration and task-specific mixing determine how each layer contributes
to prediction. Calibration is particularly effective for RN50 on EuroSAT,
and the selected layer weights vary across datasets and backbones. LAMP-F
adds prototype adaptation, with the largest gains when few support images
are available. Caching the response to prototype changes makes their evaluation
inexpensive relative to constructing the regional predictors. The results
highlight the value of the visual information already present in a frozen
encoder and show how to use it through complementary residual corrections.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented LAMP, a training-free method that combines global and regional predictions from multiple layers of a frozen vision–language encoder. Each branch retains its native feature dimension and independently fits the same support-label residual; their corrections are then combined in class-score space. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared training-free RN50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, while matching or exceeding representative methods that require training at higher support budgets. LAMP-F adds text-anchored prototype adaptation and uses a cached response to update the predictions exactly. Beyond these accuracy gains, LAMP provides a way to combine features of different dimensions without learning a shared projection. Its separation of branch fitting, score fusion, and prototype updates offers a foundation for studying task-specific layer selection and developing more scalable residual prediction methods.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LAMP,这是一种无培训方法,结合了来自多层冷冻视觉-语言编码器的全球和区域预测。 每个分支保留其原生特征维度并独立地符合相同的支持-标签剩余;然后将其校正合并为分级空间. LAMP在比较的无培训的RN50方法中以4,8和16发子弹达到最先进的平均准确性,同时匹配或超过需要更高支助预算培训的代表性方法. LAMP-F添加了文本焦虑原型的适应,并使用缓存的响应来精确地更新预测. 除了这些精度增益之外,LAMP还提供了一种将不同维度的特征结合而无需学习共同预测的方法. 它分离出分支装配,分数聚和原型更新,为研究特定任务层选择和开发更可伸缩的剩余预测方法提供了基础.
